query: Hold Firm The club gathers on the benches. You step into the chalk circle, and the eyepatched dummy turns its head toward you with an audible creak. The captain's charm begins to fire. {flag(brace_notes) and flag(brace_circle) and flag(brace_footwork): You know how to stand, and why.|You have done some of the work. Not all of it.} Hold firm The hexes break on you one after another, and each lands softer than the last. When the charm finally sputters out, the club is on its feet. Lyra doesn't clap. She nods, once, which is louder. The fourteenth hex lifts you out of the circle and into the benches. The dummy turns its head back with a creak. It will be there at practice, waiting. Borrow the captain's old gauntlets The club quartermaster rents you the captain's own gauntlets for the night. They take the first blow for you, and the rest you take yourself. When the charm sputters out, the benches roar. Even in the gauntlets, the fourteenth hex lifts you out of the circle. The rental is not refunded. The dummy creaks its head back and waits.
